verdict.rationale: Appwrite documents official SDKs implicitly through its API-driven products (auth, databases, storage, functions) and provides an official CLI and MCP server for programmatic/agentic access, with hands-on probes confirming both run. However, the evidence pack never explicitly enumerates or links official client SDKs (e.g., language-specific SDK docs/repos) as distinct artifacts, relying instead on CLI/MCP tooling as proxies. missing for 10: direct evidence of official multi-language SDK documentation/repos, SDK versioning/maintenance signals, and independent developer corroboration of SDK usage quality.
